checks: Main mode switch discloses coordinate transfer and unknown conditions, reads free status only, and does not spend a provider search
Bus/subway route cards display real normalized stop/line/time/fare/transfer data and reference markers; wheelchair condition is preserved but never presented as verified, AI-selected or GPS-ready
Candidate selection needs no new provider request, retains keyboard focus, keeps missing fare unknown and opens reference-position details without guessed route lines
320px/393px/landscape, result-mode resize and saved/route tab return preserve the transit candidate state without horizontal overflow
Changing input clears prior route/markers; provider failure is distinct from no candidate and never exposes raw provider errors/keys
Cancel ignores a late provider response without retrying or restoring stale candidates
Untrusted provider names are rendered as plain text in cards and map details
Switching back to walking or an explicit local demo clears transit state and preserves original route/building protections
